# Audit results (generated by `python -m js3 audit`; audit labels only, held-out refused)

Samples: `audit/samples.json` (seed 20261122); verdicts: `audit/labels.csv`; filter v1.0 (the version the samples were drawn from).

## 1. Hand verdict vs filter v1.0, by stratum

| stratum | n | filter wrong | wrong / n | Wilson 95% |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| random rejects (uniform; the only part that supports a rate) | 30 | 11 | 37% | 22%–54% |
| closest calls (5 on each side of the threshold; supports no rate) | 10 | 3 | 30% | 11%–60% |
| random kept | 15 | 2 | 13% | 4%–38% |

**What 30 random rejects can say:** 11 of 30 rejected postings were marked relevant by hand. With 95% confidence the share of rejects Hemanth would want lies between 22% and 54%: about 210 to 524 of the 962 rejected postings outside the held-out set. This is an estimate from one sample of 30, not a measured rate for all postings.
